chunks: Ahmad, from ʿAbd al-ʿAẓīm, from Hishām ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
“This is a path of ʿAlī, straight.”

key_terms.صِرَاطُ: path; the way of guidance and direction
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: ʿAlī; Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام as identified in this wording
key_terms.قَالَ: he said; indicates the Imam’s transmitted statement
key_terms.مُسْتَقِيمٌ: straight; upright, direct, and without deviation

ai.seo_question: How does this narration connect the straight path to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a reported reading or interpretive rendering that identifies the straight path with ʿAlī عليه السلام. In Shia tradition, it highlights the centrality of wilayah and divinely-guided leadership in understanding the path of guidance.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad, from Abdul Azeem, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
[15:41] He said: This is a Path of Ali, Straight’.
en.sarwar: 63. Ahmad has narrated from ‘Abd al-‘Azim from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl from abu Hamza from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following.

“Jibril brought this verse as this. “. . but most human beings turn away (from Wilaya of Ali (Leadership with Divine Authority) in disbelief.” [17:89] He said, “Jibril brought this verse as this “Say,” Truth comes from your Lord.(about Wilaya of Ali Leadership with Divine Authority) Let people have faith or disbelieve as they chose.” For the unjust (to the family of Muhammad) We have prepared a fire. .” [18:29]
